summary: Reconciled the main question's account with the bound that is now measured instead of read: I revised its rationale to add that an elected leader hearing from nobody is already a follower at its first CheckQuorum check with an unchanged term (indices 45/46 of CheckRun 4393d47e3d51423390832c2b3d736512), so the incumbent-forged leader overlap lasts one election timeout of the incumbent's own clock in the silent case; replaced the corresponding limitation (which had said the overlap was unquantified) with the measured bound plus its conditions (it does not follow under partial-quorum traffic or with CheckQuorum disabled); added the sixth receipt to the executions and to the joint_history; and kept every witness, source and the conclusion violated with defect_claim asserted unchanged. Validation passed with no execution requested. Remaining scope: single process with hand-delivered messages, one tick configuration, and the persistence loop's exact one-message-per-tick cadence.
